messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Russo <anna.russo@mediq.ai>, Mediq Procurement <procurement@mediq.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Provenance & Redaction Matrix — next steps for DPA alignment

Hi Anna / Mediq team —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, I attached a first-pass "Provenance & Redaction Matrix" that maps common prompt/response flows to the operational controls we can commit to in the DPA and onboarding docs. High-level asks from Redwood:

- Confirm which data classes you want redacted at ingestion vs. flagged for post-processing (see column C in the spreadsheet).
- Confirm whether you require a permanent no-train commitment for the EU subset of data or if time-bound retention + opt-out suffices.
- Decide on export channels for derivatives: API+audit vs. SFTP escrow for exports > 50GB/month.

Key notes in the sheet: we propose a redaction-first default for PII and PHI, with an obvious opt-out toggle for model improvement at the account level. If Mediq requires "no-training" as a legal guarantee, we will map that to an operational flow (isolation + KV eviction + forwarding to a dedicated non-learning variant) — that has some throughput tradeoffs we can quantify in the Dedicated contract.

Attachments: provenance-matrix-v1.xlsx (draft)

Next steps: can you confirm the data-class CSV by EOD Thu (3 July)? We can then lock the wording for the DPA exhibit. Once we have that confirmation, our ops team (Dev) will assign an implementation ETA for redaction and the non-learning route.

Thanks,
Jonas
VP, Product Partnerships
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Anna Russo <anna.russo@mediq.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mediq Procurement <procurement@mediq.ai>, legal@mediq.ai
Date: Tue, 01 Jul 2025 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Provenance & Redaction Matrix — next steps for DPA alignment

Jonas —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the matrix. A few clarifying questions from our side after reviewing with Legal & Security:

1) "Redaction-first default" — can you confirm whether redaction happens client-side (we push sanitized payloads) or server-side (Redwood redacts after ingestion)? We prefer client-side for our most sensitive endpoints but need a fallback.

2) If we take the permanent no-train option for clinical notes from our US patients, will Redwood commit to dedicated non-learning hardware, or is the promise contractual only? We need operational evidence (audit logs / configuration screenshots) as part of our security pack.

3) For prompt/response ownership: we want explicit language that derivatives (fine-tuned artifacts, embeddings) produced from our data are either returned to us on demand or restricted from reuse by Redwood. Can you outline the export flow and SLA?

Sending the data-class list as requested (attached). We can aim to confirm columns A–D by EOD Thu.

Anna Russo
Head of Integrations & Security
Mediq Health
anna.russo@mediq.ai | +1 (212) 555-9876

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Russo <anna.russo@mediq.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Jul 2025 13:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Provenance & Redaction Matrix — next steps for DPA alignment

Anna / team —

Appreciate the review. Quick clarifications from legal/controls perspective (high level; we can draft precise DPA exhibit language after your confirmation):

- Redaction placement: we support both. Client-side redaction (your preferred) is simplest and eliminates the need for Redwood to process the raw sensitive values. Server-side redaction is available with strict logging and chain-of-custody proofs (audit logs showing raw ingestion + immediate redaction timestamps). We can include screenshots from our audit console as evidence.

- No-train operationalization: Redwood offers two options we commonly list in the DPA:
  * Contract-only no-train: legal commitment in the DPA that Redwood will not use data for model improvement; processing still occurs on our shared serving fleet.
  * Isolation+non-learning variant: we route your traffic to an isolated pool configured with the learning toggle off and enforce KV cache eviction after each session. This is an operational commitment; we provide periodic attestations (monthly) plus a one-time configuration export (system snapshot). There is a cost delta for isolation — Dev will include estimated delta.

- Derivatives/export: we will commit to returning embeddings/fine-tune artifacts on request and to prevent reuse for Redwood model training if contractually restricted. Operationally that means: exports via API (normal) or SFTP escrow for bulk transfers, all accompanied by signed audit records. SLA for bulk export (SFTP) is 5 business days after request for standard plans; expedited options exist.

We will draft exhibit text that captures: redaction placement options, the no-train choice (legal vs. operational), evidence types (audit logs, screenshots, config export), and export channels + SLAs. Jonas, please confirm the timeline for drafting the exhibit — we can share a first pass by Fri if we have the confirmed data-class CSV.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Privacy & Compliance (acting)
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Provenance & Redaction Matrix — next steps for DPA alignment

Anna / team —

Thanks for the confirmation on the timeline. Operational checklist (action items + owners / rough ETA):

1) Confirmed data-class CSV -> assign redaction tiers (Jonas / Mediq) — due 2025-07-03 EOD.
2) Client-side redaction pilot for 2 endpoints (Mediq SDK) -> Dev to provide SDK hooks + example sanitizers by 2025-07-07. Attachment: redaction-implementation-checklist.md
3) Isolation/no-train option quote -> Dev + Sales (Marissa) to provide cost delta and throughput impact by 2025-07-10.
4) Audit evidence bundle -> Ops to export sanitized screenshots + ingestion logs for first 30 days post-launch; sample export by 2025-07-14.
5) Bulk export process (SFTP escrow) -> Legal to finalize exhibit language; Ops to standby for SFTP account provisioning upon sign-off.

Notes: the isolated non-learning pool will require a short onboarding window (expected 5 business days to reconfigure routing and policy rules) and will have different autoscaling characteristics; we'll include recommended capacity buffers in the quote.

If Mediq confirms client-side redaction everywhere, the isolation path is optional and we can proceed with a lighter-weight contractual no-train commitment plus enhanced audit logs.

I'll post the SDK hooks and checklist to the shared Drive link (HubSpot:HS-3412) and ping Marissa for the quote.

Cheers,
Dev Patel
Principal Systems Engineer, Inference Ops
